Definition: Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Succoth = "booths"; 1) the site where Jacob put up booths for his cattle and built a house for himself; apparently east of the Jordan near the ford of the torrent Jabbok and later allotted to the tribe of Gad; 2) the first stopping place of the Israelites when they left Egypt
